newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Frantschach says in talks with Polish government.
newsitem.headline: Frantschach says in talks with Polish government.

text.p: Austrian papermaker Frantschach AG said it was in negotiations with the privatisation ministry of the Polish government but said a possible acquisition of papermaker Celuloza Swiecie was not imminent.
Frantschach is part of the Framondi consortium, which includes South Africa's Mondi Minorco Paper, Bank Handlowy and Lasy PaEstwowe.
"Framondi clarifies that media reports saying the acquisition of Celuloza Swiecie S.A. is imminent, are incorrect," Frantschach said in a statement.
"We solely confirm negotiations with the privatisation ministry of the Polish government," it added.
Poland's treasury ministry aims to sell up to 65 percent of shares in Celuloza and float 15 percent of its shares on the Warsaw Stock Exchange this month.
Recent media reports have said Frantschach is the main contender in the race to buy Poland's biggest paper and cellulose producer. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12258
